chapter: On the road with the Moores
title: Ella B. Moore invites him on the road
summary: Ella B. Moore, with protege Nellie Lutcher, asks him to travel; he wins third prize and his mother agrees on condition he is back for school.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: So Mr. Shelton Brooks said, 'That was good; they like you, and you just go over there and rest. you know, and so that's what happened. Then the next thing I know, this lady, Ella B. Moore -- this is Tish Moore's partner -- she was -- a great singer, she was -- Nellie Letcher was her protege, you know.
Nellie Letcher. She was a popular singer some years later, you know, and --
She made a famous record, 'Fine Brown Frame.'

Made it popular, didn't she? Yeah. Uh-huh, she caused a tragedy too. She used to walk in her sleep, you see. Ella B. Moore was kind of like a motherly woman, you see, and I guess that's why she probably made her protege because she was trying to take care of her at that time, you see. That's back in the '20's.

And Miss Moore asked me how would I like to travel, you know. So I said, well, 'yes, ma'am, sure I would,' I said, 'but, I said, I have to ask a lady, the lady next door would it be all right, you see, if I was to travel on the road. And I have to ask J. D. which later became Chuckles, my partner, see, because -- she said, 'Well, you do that.' And she asked me my parents' name, and I told her that my -- my only parents that were in the city at the time was my mother and her mother, you see, and I have to get their permissions (inaudible) and so forth.
She asked me where we lived and so forth and she
would come and talk to my mother and get permission to take me on the road traveling, you see. As I say, school was out. So I was free, right? So that's what she did.

Well anyhow, in the contest the contestants would have to come out and line up across the stage as they always do, and the Master of Ceremonies would come along behind him and put his hand over their head, and the audience would applaud how they liked the amateur, you see. So I won the third prize, you see.

And that's what happened there at the 81 Theater. So the next thing I know is my -- my mother was telling me that some people was at the house, and they wanted to know if it would be all right to take me in a show somewhere on the road with them, and my mother liked the Chinch and Ella B. Moore shows. She had been seeing them throughout the years, you know. And she said she was going to give the lady permission, but I couldn't stay away no longer than until when school starts again. I would have to be back into Atlanta, Georgia.
This was with the Brown Skin Models?
So this was really your first chance to get involved with show business?
